checked_claims.note: Dimension d=20 matches 3*5-3+8. Packet duality W_24 H^24(20) ≅ W_-16 H^BM_16 and Q(-12)(20)=Q(8) are applied correctly; no degree/twist off-by-one found.

Fiber of forgetful f:M_{5,8}→M_{5,7} is a 7-punctured genus-5 curve, so fiberwise H^q=0 for q>1 and only Leray rows q=0,1 contribute to total degree 24. Stack-versus-coarse is harmless at Q coefficients; non-properness of f is standard for this Leray setup.
The fiber sequence 0→H^1(C)→H^1(C\{p_i})→Q(-1)^{⊕6}→0 is the correct rank-(n-1)=6 puncture quotient; H denotes the genus-five symplectic local system on M_{5,7}.

THM-0005 gives CKgP and tautological Chow for M_{5,7} (c(5)=7). Packet language derives algebraicity of pure-weight constant-coefficient cohomology, so W_24 H^24(M_{5,7};Q) being Tate of type Q(-12) is the intended reading. This does not upgrade pure Tate to a full tautological-generation theorem beyond what the packet already ties to CKgP.

Sufficiency is only relative to still-open controls: the puncture-quotient parity argument, possible nonsplit extension effects in 0→H→R^1f_*Q→Q(-1)^6→0, and Leray differentials affecting the weight-24 subquotient. Reduction is therefore not cleaned down to a single vanishing.
No supplied claim (THM-0005 or otherwise) yields vanishing or Tate-ness of W_24 H^23(M_{5,7};H). Attempt status is proposed with explicit gap_markers; the target pure-weight statement is not proved.

finding_candidates.statement: For the forgetful reduction M_{5,8}→M_{5,7}, the load-bearing term W_24 H^23(M_{5,7};H) with H the rank-10 genus-five symplectic variation is not constrained by THM-0005 CKgP/tautological Chow, which address constant-coefficient pure-weight algebraicity on M_{5,7}, not nonconstant local systems. Without an independent vanishing or Tate theorem for this group, the pure-weight Tate claim for M_{5,8} does not follow.

Even granting graded control of H and of Q(-1)^⊕6 separately, the possibly nonsplit extension 0→H→R^1f_*Q→Q(-1)^⊕6→0 and nonzero Leray differentials between the (24,0) and (23,1) lines can alter the weight-24 pure subquotient of H^24(M_{5,8}). Strictness of weights alone does not eliminate or force Tate-ness of that subquotient.

The constant puncture-quotient contribution through H^23(M_{5,7};Q(-1)^⊕6) to weight 24 relies on a parity-sensitive form of the CKgP-to-pure-cohomology implication that the abbreviated THM-0005 statement does not independently supply; odd-degree pure pieces of the needed weight are not discharged by the packet text alone.

strongest_attack: The Leray (23,1) contribution W_24 H^23(M_{5,7};H) from the nonconstant genus-five symplectic local system is uncontrolled by packet CKgP/algebraicity (constant-coefficient only). Together with uncomputed extension class and possible Leray differentials on the weight-24 graded piece, this blocks any conclusion that W_24 H^24(M_{5,8}) is a Tate sum of Q(-12); the attempt correctly leaves A6 open and is therefore incomplete, not a proof.
